independence_semantics.distinct_vector_across_replicas: samples a new policy-sampling stream and a new environment stream for each replica, so the three paired differences are not driven by one shared random path
independence_semantics.same_policy_rng_with_new_env_seed: would vary only the environment; policy sampling noise stays correlated across replicas, so replicas are not independent replication units and paired differences inherit a shared policy-noise component
independence_semantics.common_random_numbers_across_arms: arms A and B share the whole vector, so shared noise cancels within a pair; it does not remove seed-specific luck and it does not create independence between pairs. After the policies diverge, identical seeds no longer imply identical draws, so CRN only guarantees identical draw streams while the consumed state matches
independence_semantics.analysis_unit: paired training seed, n=3, descriptive only
